spec.ticket_text:
Team leads who look after several projects keep switching between boards to see what is
open, because issues can only be listed one project at a time. We want a single org-wide issue
list, GET /issues, that people can narrow down by status, priority, assignee, project, and a search
on the title (1 to 100 characters, case does not matter). Filters combine, so "open, high priority,
assigned to me" is one request.

The list should behave like every other list in TeamTrack: cursor and limit, the
{"items": [...], "next_cursor": ...} envelope, items shaped like IssueOut. It must never show deleted
issues or issues from archived projects, and it only ever shows the caller's own organization: a
project or assignee from another org should look as if it does not exist (404), and a bad filter
value is a 422. Everyone can use it, viewers included.

The full spec is in docs/features/f1.md.
